resources.string: , after another long session of shitposting on your favorite Norwegian Deep-Sea Basket Weaving imageboard, you realize you're out of snacks and head out to restock. On the way back, you're stopped by a nun handing out pamphlets for service at a church you've never heard of. In a fit of uncharacteristic adventurousness, you decide to check it out, partially motivated by the fact that the nun was pretty cute. The address on the pamphlet leads you to an impressively large old stone church, and despite being very near your home you don't think you've ever seen it before. There are only a few other people attending, but you put aside your misgivings and head in. The moment you step foot through the church's door, you feel the blood rush to your head just before you black out.

After a long period of restless unconsciousness, filled with waves of burning heat washing over your body, you wake up. Feeling weirdly well rested, you look around. The first thing you notice is that you're in a dim, windowless chapel, tapestries on the walls and lit only by candles, laying on a hard alter with a thick cloth over top. The second thing you notice as you sit up is that you're stark naked, covered by only a thin blanket waist down to preserve your modesty. As your confusion mounts, you realize there's a group of nuns kneeling next to the alter and watching you intently. The moment you see them they light up in happiness, and the blonde one at the front stands to speak.

My Lord! You're awake! How do you feel? Are you comfortable? Oh, I had only hoped to dream, but just the moment we saw you, it- ...Who, am I? Well, your High Priestess of course. Do you not... recognize me? ...Hmm. What about the other Priestesses? Not... them either. Okay. Um, that's alright. What about around us? The church, the symbols, the iconography, the... the feeling of divinity that saturates this whole room? Anything? ...nothing. You, don't know any of this at all. O-oh. I... please, allow me a moment..
The excitement is replaced by concern, confusion, and a hint of despair on all the nuns save the blonde. After a long steadying breath, she reopens her eyes and faces you resolutely.

We are absolutely certain that you are or Lord in the flesh; your aura is unmistakable, it fills and resonates within us in a way that nothing else in the world could. But this amnesia is... beyond our expectations.
Um... My Lord... How do you, feel?

That's a fucking lot to take in. But you did pick out one thing - this is apparently some kind of sex church, and the women in front of you are indeed pretty damn sexy.
